reviews.t: Magnetic eyeliner dried out within 2nd use
reviews.x: My first clue to the quality of this product was when I opened the box. The packaging - just see the photo included in the seller's advertisement - has the word "Eyelashes" misspelled. All over the box. It actually comes that way. I wanted to love this product, but the eyeliner is a tiny tube and dried up almost completely by the 2nd day I tried to wear them. Otherwise, this magnetic eyeliner thing is a great idea. The quality here is just extremely lacking. My eyes also burned and itched like m

reviews.t: Good lashes, but eyeliner was goopy and got all over my lashes
reviews.x: These lashes are nice, and they stick to the eyeliner well. However, the eyeliner was so clumpy and goopy that I could not apply it without getting it all over my real lashes. And it was very hard to wipe off. I ended up pulling out several lashes trying to wipe the extra off my natural lashes during application. I'm not ok with losing lashes every time I use this eyeliner, so I'll be trying a different one.  Update: And the eyeliner kept coming off for 2 days after I thought I had removed it. I

reviews.t: OMG It looks like I know what I'm doing!
reviews.x: Took me like 5 minutes to put these lashes on. Threw on a pair of large eye contacts and wow, I wish I had an event to go to right now because I'm so impressed with myself lol! I've never been able to put on a pair of regular falsies but these were so easy! Can't wait to wear them in public!

reviews.t: Dried out - couldn’t even use it
reviews.x: I just got it and tried to use it immediately after opening, and the tube of eyeliner is completely dried out. I can’t even use it.

I was excited to try this but it's a hassle. It looks good to wear but they are super uncomfortable and the strip is so thick. The eyeliner is very thick and pasty. The brush was all wonky so it was hard to get straight lines and I'm a seasoned liquid eyeliner user. It also takes FOREVER to dry. It's also almost impossible to remove. Even with makeup remover. I don't really have any positives about this except they do look pretty and they do stay put but omg I couldn't wait to take them off. And

[[VIDEOID:bf997494c3b41117cc89d422c78021d4]] I bought the 3 pack lashes. They felt nice and lightweight and weren’t so full or long looking like fans on my eyes. I definitely do like the lashes, my only issue was the eyeliner. I seen a lot of complaints about the difficulty of removing the eyeliner but it’s honestly not so bad. It’s very sticky, but can be removed overall if you just rub a little harder. My only issue was, the eyeliner seemed dry, the rim of the top was dried out and clumped up.

reviews.t: Perfect for someone with no cosmetology experience
reviews.x: I love this product . A friend recommended after I told her how great her lashes looked  . That’s when she told me about these and ever since then I’ve been hooked . This is my second purchase and I use these when going on a date, an important meeting or just when I’m in the mood for that glam look. I mean come on eyeliner and magnet in one . The perfect marriage! The lashes last a long time and I only bought my second set because they where 3D. Now I just can’t live without any of  them. It use

reviews.t: This is a great idea, but it came up short.
reviews.x: The very first time I opened the magnetic liner (which was the same day it arrive at my house) it was completely dry, sticky, and clumpy; and the applicator brush was roughed up. It took a lot of effort to smear the thick product onto my lid and it did not look pretty. The lashes are honestly too long and somehow, both too sparse and too heavy looking. The only pro, is that they did stay on for several hours. But for the second application, the product was simply too dry to come out if the conta

All three lashes in this set are pretty and lightweight.  Cons: chunky, dry hard to put on liner.  ( and I’ve been using liquid liner since highschool in 2004) the magnets take off the liner with them so if you don’t get it perfect the first try then you have start all over and clean the magnets and apply the liner. Cleaning the magnets was not easy as the liner clumps up and gets into the lashes. I’m honestly surprised to see so many raving reviews on this product. I will be trying to reuse the

So these have served me for a few nights out, but I’m going to have to replace them soon. Here were my problems: 1) the eyeliner is terrible — it was dry and sticky and I had to get an eyeliner from a different brand after one use. 2) the magnets on the lashes were really easy to tear off when taking them off their little magnetic holder. Once a magnet goes, the whole lash becomes useless. Ultimately I think I got my money’s worth but it’s a bummer to have to replace them after just a few uses.

I have ordered this brand a couple times now, and their lashes are always good. They have the best magnetic liner I’ve found. It holds forever compared to drug store brands. But applicator that comes with this 3 pack was useless. The brush is too long for the tube, so it’s bent and frayed, like a dollar store paint brush, so it can’t be used to actually put the magnetic eyeliner on with any precision. It’s a shame. I really liked the other sets I’ve ordered from them.

The liner came completely dried out. I sprayed the brush with setting spray to at least try it out & that helped a little but obviously not ideal for long-term use. It's as if there's no product at all in the tube. The lashes went on easily, but the inner corners lifted quite a bit no matter how many times I tried to push them back down onto the liner. Lashes are natural & fluffy. Liner is very difficult to remove, it clumps a lot. Not a fan.

reviews.t: Really? What the heck is your problem
reviews.x: Wow really the eyeliner was All gross and half dried up all Gunky and sticky on eyelid cause for some reason I wanted to attempt to put this crappy formula on my eye why is it still sticky the only thing good about this product was the lashes but that’s frankly not a good enough reason to buy this junk I might have just gotten a bad batch but you know what for 20$ I really shouldn’t be having any freaking problems.

I loved them so much I bought a set for my mother in law, a set for my aunt in law and a set for myself!!! I’ve had many different type of magnetic eyelashes but these feel soooo comfortable I like these the best!! To some it is difficult to remove I use regular eye liner under the magnetic eyeliner and it works for me!!! They look gorgeous on!! Now that we wear masks 24-7 it’s all about brows and eyelashes!!

I was really surprised how satisfied I was! I’m not a lash type of girl besides some mascara an some eyeliner. So when it came to these it provided that BOOM I was missing. My one down fall was the eyeliner you use for the magnets to work in general dried up by the third set I applied. So when ordering recommend getting a back up eyeliner that compatible with this type of product.

I really like this product, but the eyeliner was dry when I got it. Rather than send it back I decided to put some water in it and mix it. It worked, but I feel like I should not have had to do that with a brand new product.  Otherwise, the product is great and the lashes look amazing. Considering I had never put lashes on before this, this product made it super easy to do!

reviews.t: Easy cleanup and not damaging real eye lashes
reviews.x: I read the reviews but underestimated how hard it would be take off the magnetic liner. I went though 4-5 make up removal wipes just to get the liner off off one eye… and even after this, I felt like it was not completely off. I would’ve rated 0 stars to “easy to remove” if I could. Will be returning as the aftermath of cleaning up the liner is too troublesome.

reviews.t: Seems misleading-not magnetic but glue is holding them on
reviews.x: The lashes are OK but heavy when applied.  The "magnetic' liner is thick and hard to apply evenly.  I let it completely dry each time and it is adhesive that keeps them in place.  Taking them off is a mess with thick gummy glue sticking to the lashes and me.  No way the lashes can be cleaned-I tried.  Lasted only 4 applications and magnets came off the lashes.

reviews.t: Lashes are good, liner is terrible
reviews.x: I was excited to try these based on the reviews and videos however it did not come as advertised. The liner was completely dried up which was a major bummer considering I bought this for a special occasion and didn’t have another option. The company needs to do better quality control and not ship product that is poor quality. Beware…you get what you pay for.

reviews.t: Eyeliner dried up or none at all
reviews.x: The eyelashes are beautiful but the eyeliner tube either had no liquid inside or was completely dried out. As you can see, the bristles were frayed upon opening and were so hard. I was very excited to try these based on reviews and a review I saw on YT. I guess I got a defect. I returned this item, I'll be looking for something more reliable.

I expected more from this product because of all the glowing reviews. Eyeliner was dry and clumpy; very very messy and hard to apply. Also really hard to remove from skin. The first time I tried the lashes one of the magnets came off so that lash is useless now. The lashes themselves are ok; nothing special IMO. I would try a different brand!

reviews.t: eyeliner came dry and clumpy, bottle feels empty
reviews.x: [[VIDEOID:be7358de7fa313bf12a60e11a6072d03]] okay i ordered so much stuff and was looking forward to trying this but unfortunately the eyeliner came dry and clumpy and the bottle itself feels half empty and i can’t even draw a simple eyeliner 😓 lashes feels awesome though it was lightweight like described. too bad i can’t use it

I was really surprised but they work really well. And it doesn’t irritate my eyelids it doesn’t feel like there’s anything on my eyelids which I love.  the only thing that I didn’t like was the magnetic eyeliner there wasn’t enough in the bottle and it dried out really easily but it worked really well When I was able to use it

I tried these on for about 30 seconds before I had to take them off. They were very heavy on my eyelids and did not feel good at all. PLUS the eyeliner you use to put them off was killer to take off. It took me four days to get it off even using make-up wipes and was the consistency of tar. Super gross. Don't buy these.

I bought this item and the eyeliner itself was dry as soon as i opened the package. I then ordered a replacement and returned the first package. The replacement also had dry eyeliner so I wasn't able to use either of them. I returned both packages and I still haven't gotten my refund. This is a huge dissappointment.

claims.text: Many reviewers report the magnetic eyeliner arrived or quickly became dried out, clumpy, or goopy, making it hard to use.
Reviewers frequently praise the lashes themselves as lightweight, comfortable, and easy to apply, even for beginners.
Several reviewers complain about the applicator brush being bent, frayed, or otherwise poor quality.
Some reviewers find the eyeliner difficult to remove and note the magnets can pull off the liner or tear off the lashes.
A few reviewers mention the eyeliner is thick, pasty, and slow to dry.
